title: Level 2 (Intermediate) - C-18
notes:
West leads the ♥A against 5♠ doubled. After winning the first trick he continues the suit at trick 2. It appears that South's only other loser is in diamonds. However, South should be careful. The bidding indicates that West has a very distributional hand and East's double of the final contract suggests he might have all 5 of the outstanding trumps.

If South ruffs at trick 2, he will not be able to prevent the loss of a trump trick to East if East was dealt 5 spades.

South can make the contract on this layout by discarding his diamond loser at trick 2. A diamond trick must be lost in any event and by losing this trick early, South prevents the defense from scoring a trump trick. If a third round of hearts is continued, the ruff can be taken in dummy. South can draw all of the outstanding trumps and easily take the balance.
